name: Crobat
description: Its hind limbs have become another set of wings. Crobat expertly maneuvers its four wings to dart in exquisite fashion through even the most confined caves without losing any speed.

moves.name: Gust
moves.description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target drowsy.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: The user bites the target with viciously sharp fangs to inflict damage.

moves.name: Air Cutter
moves.description: The user launches razor-like wind to slash the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Cross Poison
moves.description: A slashing attack with a toxic blade that may also poison the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky.

moves.name: Leech Life
moves.description: The user attacks by draining the target's blood. Some of the damage dealt to the target is absorbed by the user to restore their own HP.
